description: If I buy this token on Arc, can I get out? For a token address or Uniswap v4 pool id on Arc: a real buy-then-sell round trip inside one eth_call through the pool hook (nothing spent) or, for ERC-20-USDC pools, both legs quoted. Returns whether the sell goes through, the round-trip cost, depth, and flags with reasons. The answer names its method. Free, one at a time (ten a minute).

query.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex).

usdc.description: Test size in USDC, default 1, max 1000.

name: arc_exit_check
